title: Include setup before interpreting an effort reduction
method: Synthetic workload. Baseline =60+15+5 hours; assisted delivery=44+21+7; setup adds6. Reductions are10% before setup and2.5% including it. Distinguish recurring and one-time effort in a real study.
alt: Include setup before interpreting an effort reduction. Baseline: 80 person-hours for 20 tasks, Assisted delivery: 72 person-hours for 20 tasks, Assisted plus setup: 78 person-hours for 20 tasks. Illustrative data.
